records.title: Client-Side Data Storage Boundary & Local-Only Guarantee
records.hunterHypothesis: User financial transactions, account numbers, and cash flow amounts could be leaked or stored on an external database server.

adversarialValidation.result: Disproved. Codebase inspection confirms zero outbound HTTP API calls (`fetch`, `axios`, or WebSocket transmissions) to any remote database. All state persistence is strictly isolated in browser `window.localStorage` under the dedicated key `balanced_finance_storage_v1`. No third-party analytics, remote logs, or tracking beacons exist.
adversarialValidation.conclusion: Hypothesis rejected. Zero data leakage to server.

records.title: Network Egress & Third-Party Telemetry Auditing
records.hunterHypothesis: Background banking simulation might reach out to external real financial APIs without consent.

adversarialValidation.result: Disproved. The automated feed is completely contained inside a deterministic local generator using pure client-side timers (`setInterval`) and in-memory mock pools. No banking credentials, OAuth tokens, or network sockets are exposed.

records.title: CSV Formula & Content Injection in Transaction Ledger
records.hunterHypothesis: User-supplied transaction descriptions exported to CSV could trigger DDE formula execution or script injection in spreadsheet viewers.

adversarialValidation.result: Disproved. Transaction descriptions are properly quoted and inner double-quotes are escaped with double quotes (`replace(/"/g, '""')`). Furthermore, in-DOM rendering relies on standard React JSX escaping, preventing any DOM-based XSS.
adversarialValidation.conclusion: Hypothesis rejected. CSV and DOM rendering are safe.

records.title: SVG Scripting & Vector Injection in AnalyticsBento
records.hunterHypothesis: Dynamic SVG coordinate generation and path smoothing might allow attribute or script injection.

adversarialValidation.result: Disproved. SVG elements are constructed through typed React JSX elements without `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. Points and curves are purely mathematical Catmull-Rom cubic bezier calculations clamped to safe numerical boundaries.
adversarialValidation.conclusion: Hypothesis rejected. SVG pipeline is immune to script injection.

records.title: Manual Transaction Numeric and Category Sanitization
records.hunterHypothesis: Negative or non-numeric amounts could cause NaN corruption in balance calculations.

adversarialValidation.result: Disproved. Numerical amounts are validated with `parseFloat` and guarded by `isNaN(parsedAmount) || parsedAmount <= 0`, preventing corrupted numeric states or unexpected overflows.
adversarialValidation.conclusion: Hypothesis rejected. Input validation is strictly enforced.
